name: lazy-obsidian
title: LazyObsidian
description: Capture anything from macOS into Obsidian with progressive AI automation
author: pysol-dev

commands.name: capture
commands.title: Lazy Capture
commands.description: Capture selected text, browser links, and notes into your Obsidian vault

preferences.name: vaultPath
preferences.title: Vault Path(s)
preferences.description: Optional comma-separated absolute vault paths. Leave empty to auto-detect from Obsidian.

preferences.name: openOnCapture
preferences.title: Open in Obsidian
preferences.label: Open the note in Obsidian after capture
preferences.description: Uses core Obsidian URI. Does not require Advanced URI.

preferences.name: excludedFolders
preferences.title: Excluded Folders
preferences.description: Comma-separated folder names to hide from folder pickers (in addition to .obsidian/.git/.trash).
